entities.name: Selective ester saponification
observations: One aromatic ethyl ester is converted to a carboxylic acid while a second ester and tertiary amide remain unchanged.
The matching database record reports NaOH in ethanol followed by HCl acid workup.

entities.name: NaOH ethanol HCl
observations: Saponification uses NaOH in ethanol or aqueous alcoholic medium, followed by HCl acidification to furnish the free carboxylic acid.

entities.name: Ester hydrolysis reagent classes
observations: Plausible alternatives include KOH instead of NaOH, aqueous methanol or ethanol as solvent, and mineral-acid workup such as HCl.
Oxidants, dehydrogenation agents, and cyclization reagents are not implicated by the bond changes.
